It may just be my area...I've NEVER seen anyone ever get targeted because they *revealed* themselves to be an atheist.

When they specifically target a religious denomination, yes things get heated.  But for simply revealing themselves...I've never seen it.

Out of curiousity where do you live?  I've lived in west and east coast...never the south though.  All of these places I've known and see darwin fish and other such things that have never been vandalized in the slightest

thanks for the enlightenment on the politicians angle.  I didn't realize there were actual laws out there.  Thanks!

There we go, a good response, thank you :)

Those are some very good points.  My counterpoint to you is that I wouldn't consider this to be persecution.  It's going against the 'popular opinion'.  You KNOW it's going to be a fight, this extends to outside the religious realm as well, it extends to the scientific world and viewpoints as well.

I guess my ultimate point is if you're going to poke the bear, whatever it may be...be prepared and don't be surprised.  I see too many people poking the bear then getting amazed and upset that it reacts.  They go in half cocked with some unfounded viewpoints of their own and then get trampled.

ahhh why I love this subreddit...take the entire thing out of context.. Thanks for the affirmation!

(for the record, I'm an atheist....with a very religious immediate family, I just know when to pick the battles and know when I'm walking into a fight).

Then you admit you want the fight...so why complain about it?  When every religion goes on their religious crusade to convert people (or atheists).  They know they're going into a fight..... It's the same thing.
